description: Adds (or with negative days subtracts) N business days to a date on a joint calendar (NYSE, Fedwire/FedACH, TARGET2, UK) and lists the holidays skipped. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

calendars.description: Comma list of calendars; a day is a business day only if open in all. XNYS (NYSE), FED (Fedwire/FedACH), TARGET2 (EUR), UK-ENG. Aliases: NYSE, US, ACH, EUR, UK. Default FED.

name: add_business_days
title: Add or subtract N business days
